title: GovCoreStructuredError
description: Unified structured error (API structured_errors[]). Wire keys from shared/naming.py.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (HEALTH_FAILED, INGEST_FAILED, …). Langfuse error_type should use the same value.

error_type.description: Alias for code when emitting Langfuse metadata only; not required on API if code is set.
